run_merge_traj: run merge_traj.py with a root directory path to merge VASP checkpoint trajectories into full trajectories
extract_file_from_zip: extract a specific file from a zip archive to a target directory using extract_file
merge_vasp_checkpoints: merge intermediate VASP relaxation checkpoint files into a single full ASE trajectory file
read_vasp_xml_trajectory: read vasprun.xml files and construct an ASE trajectory using ase.io.read with vasp-xml format
write_full_trajectory: write a merged ASE trajectory to a .traj file using ase.io.write
